items.title: 10.6 Induced emf aur Faraday ka law (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.6 in the book's order (PDF 238-240), with the Eq. 10.23 reference correction and self-checks.

blocks.text: Experiment (kar ke dekhna) se dekha gaya hai ke jab koi conductor magnetic field ke aar paar chalta hai to us ke dono siron ke darmiyan electromotive force (emf) induce (paida) hoti hai. Chalte conductor ki yeh emf battery jaisi hai: agar conductor ke siron ko taar se jor kar band circuit bana dein to us mein current behne lagta hai.

blocks.title: Motional emf
blocks.text: Magnetic field ke aar paar conductor ki motion (chalna ya hilna) se paida hone wali emf ko motional emf kehte hain.

Fig. 10.13 ka experiment dekhein. Lambai L ki conducting rod do parallel (saath saath, barabar faasle par) metal rails (dhaati patriyon) par rakhi hai jin ka faasla bhi L hai. Patriyon ke siron c aur d ke darmiyan galvanometer laga hai. Is tarah complete loop abcda banta hai. Uniform magnetic field B kaghaz ke andar ki taraf hai. Shuru mein rod ruki ho to galvanometer koi current nahi dikhata. Agar rod ko constant (na badalne wala) velocity v se daen khaincha jaye to galvanometer current dikhata hai. Saaf hai ke yeh current rod ki field ke aar paar motion se paida hua hai; chalti rod emf ka source ban jati hai: ε = V_b − V_a = ΔV.

blocks.alt: Do horizontal (zameen ke barabar leta hua) patriyan (rails), oopar sira c aur neeche sira d, baen taraf galvanometer se juri hain. Tanbe ki rod ab (b oopar, a neeche) un ke aar paar hai; darmiyan hare hisse mein cross batate hain ke B kaghaz ke andar hai. Rod mein charge q velocity v se daen chalta hai. Current I ke teer: oopar wali patri par baen, galvanometer ke saath neeche aur neeche wali patri par daen. L patriyon ka faasla hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.13: Motional emf: kaghaz ke andar wali magnetic field mein patriyon par v se chalai gayi rod (kitab ki Figure 10.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rod daen chal rahi hai aur B kaghaz ke andar hai, is liye rod ke positive charges par force q v × B, a se b ki taraf (oopar) hai. Current rod mein oopar, oopar wali patri par c ki taraf baen, galvanometer se neeche aur neeche wali patri par daen behta hai: yani loop abcda mein anticlockwise.
Jab rod chalti hai to us ke andar ka charge q bhi usi velocity v se field B mein chalta hai aur us par Eq. 10.13 wali force lagti hai:

Right-hand rule lagane se pata chalta hai ke charge q par force F rod ke saath a se b ki taraf hai. Is liye charges rod ke upar wale sire ki taraf jama hone lagte hain: upar wale sire b par charge zyada aur neeche wale sire a par kam ho jata hai. Charge ki is nayi tarteeb se b se a ki taraf electrostatic field E banti hai, jo charge par b se a ki taraf force F_e = qE lagati hai. Jaldi hi aisa equilibrium (barabari ki halat) aa jata hai jis mein dono forces barabar hon. Agar is halat mein electric field E ho to:

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Wireless charging electromagnetic induction ke principle (qaida) par kaam karti hai (kitab mein 'woks' chhapa hai, matlab works).
Is ki amount vBL hai; negative sign (nishan) sirf direction (rukh) ki taraf ishara hai (Lenz ka law, topic 10.7). Agar v aur B ka angle θ ho to:

Induced emf ki wajah se positive charges raste abcda par behte hain, is liye diagram mein induced current anticlockwise hai. Current behne se upar wale sire ka charge kam hota hai, electric field kamzor hoti hai, magar magnetic force wahi rehti hai. Barabari magnetic force ke haq mein toot jati hai. Is liye jo charges circuit se ho kar neeche wale sire a tak pohanchte hain, unhein magnetic force phir upar sire b tak le jati hai, aur current chalta rehta hai.

blocks.title: Point to ponder!
blocks.text: Yeh heater electromagnetic induction ke principle par chalta hai. Metal ke bartan mein pani ubal raha hai magar glass (sheeshe) ke bartan mein nahi. Heater ki sheeshe ki upar wali surface (oopar ki teh) bhi chhoone mein thandi rehti hai. Surface ke bilkul neeche coil mein ac (alternating current) behta hai jo badalta magnetic flux banata hai. Bartanon se guzarne wala flux un mein emf paida karta hai. Metal ke bartan mein current banta hai jo pani garam karta hai, magar sheeshe ke bartan mein koi current nahi behta. Kyun? (Ishara: emf to dono mein banti hai, magar current ke liye conductor chahiye; sheesha insulator hai.)
